chapterInfo.content:
15
Yesu wuo ne ne wusɔreɛ
1Anuanom, afei merekae mo asɛmpa a mekaa mo, na mogyeeɛ nso, na mogyina mu nso, 2na afei wɔnam so gye mo nkwa no, sɛ mosɔ mu den sɛdeɛ mekaa mo asɛmpa no a, anyɛ saa deɛ a, na moagye adi kwa. 3#Yes 53.8-9 Na nsɛm a adi kan a me nso menyaeɛ a mede mehyɛɛ mo nsa ne sɛ: Yɛn bɔne nti Kristo wui, sɛdeɛ twerɛ nsɛm no ka no. 4#Dwom 16.10 Na wɔsiee no, na ne nnansa soɔ no wɔnyanee no, sɛdeɛ twerɛ nsɛm no ka no. 5#Luk 24.34; Mar 16.14 Na ɔmaa Kefa hunuu no, ansa na dummienu no rehu no. 6Ɛno akyiri no, ɔmaa anuanom bɛboro ahanum hunuu no prɛko; wɔn mu pii da so te ase, na ebinom adeda. 7#Luk 24.50 Ɛno akyiri no, ɔmaa Yakobo hunuu no ansa na asomafoɔ no nyinaa rehu no. 8#1 Ko 9.1 Wɔn nyinaa akyiri na ɔmaa me a mete sɛ deɛ wɔapatu awo no nso hunuu no.
9 # Efe 3.8 Na mene asomafoɔ no mu akumaa a mensɛ sɛ wɔfrɛ me ɔsomafoɔ mpo, ɛfiri sɛ metaa Nyankopɔn asafo no; 10#2 Ko 11.5; 11.23 nanso Nyankopɔn adom nti na mete sɛdeɛ meteɛ yi; na n’adom a ɔde dom me no anyɛ kwa, na mmom meyɛɛ adwuma bebree mesene wɔn nyinaa, nanso ɛnyɛ me a, na mmom Nyankopɔn adom a ɛka me ho no a. 11Enti sɛ me oo, sɛ wɔn oo, saa na yɛka, na saa na mogye diiɛ.
Awufoɔ sɔreɛ
12Na sɛ wɔka no Kristo ho sɛ wɔanyane no afiri awufoɔ mu a, adɛn na mo mu binom ka sɛ: Awufoɔ sɔreɛ nni hɔ? 13Na sɛ awufoɔ sɔreɛ nni hɔ a, na wɔannyane Kristo nso; 14na sɛ wɔannyane Kristo a, na yɛn asɛnka yɛ ɔkwa, na mo gyidie nso yɛ hunu. 15#Aso 1.22 Na wɔbɛhu yɛn sɛ Nyankopɔn ho adansekurumfoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ yɛdii Onyankopɔn adanseɛ sɛ, ɔnyanee Kristo, na sɛ awufoɔ nnyane a, ɛnneɛ na wannyane ɔno nso. 16#1 Ko 6.14 Na sɛ awufoɔ nnyane a, na wɔannyane Kristo nso. 17#1 Ko 15.14 Na sɛ wɔannyane Kristo a, na mo gyidie yɛ hunu, na moda so wɔ mo bɔne mu. 18Ɛno deɛ na wɔn a wɔdedaa Kristo mu no ayera. 19Sɛ nkwa yi mu nko ara na yɛwɔ Kristo mu anidasoɔ a, ɛnneɛ na yɛne nnipa nyinaa mu mmɔborɔfoɔ.
Kristo wusɔreɛ bɛma wɔn nyinaa asɔre bi
20 # 1 Ko 11.30; Kol 1.18 Nanso afei deɛ, wɔanyane Kristo afiri awufoɔ mu ayɛ wɔn a wɔadeda no mu aduaba a ɛdi kan. 21#Gye 3.17-19; Rom 5.12; 5.18 Na sɛdeɛ ɛnam onipa so na owuo baeɛ no, sɛ nso awufoɔ sɔreɛ nam onipa so baeɛ ne no. 22Na sɛdeɛ wɔn nyinaa wu Adam mu no, sɛ nso wɔn nyinaa bɛnya nkwa Kristo mu ne no. 23#1 Ko 15.20; 1 Te 4.16; Adi 20.5 Na obiara wɔ ne diberɛ; Kristo ne aduaba a ɛdi kan, ansa na wɔn a wɔyɛ Kristo dea, ne ba mu no, di hɔ, 24#Dan 2.44 ansa na awieeɛ no di hɔ, ɛberɛ a ɔde ahennie no bɛhyɛ Agya Nyankopɔn nsa, na watu ahennie ne ahoɔden ne tumi nyinaa aguo no. 25#Dwom 110.1; Mat 22.44 Na ɛtwa sɛ ɔdi hene kɔsi sɛ ɔde atamfoɔ no nyinaa bɛhyɛ ne nan ase. 26#Adi 20.14; 21.4 Ɔtamfoɔ a ɔdi akyire a ɔbɛtu no aguo no ne owuo. 27#Dwom 8.6 Na ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa agu ne nan ase. Na sɛ ɔka sɛ ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa agu ne nan ase a, emu da hɔ pefee sɛ deɛ ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa guu ne nan ase no nka ho. 28Na sɛ ɔnya de nnoɔma nyinaa gu ne nan ase a, ɛno ansa na ɔba no ara nso de ne ho bɛhyɛ deɛ ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa guu ne nan ase no aseɛ, na Onyankopɔn ayɛ ade nyinaa mu ade nyinaa.
Awufoɔ asubɔ
29Na anka wɔn a wɔma wɔbɔ wɔn asu ma awufoɔ no, wɔyɛ de gye deɛn? Sɛ awufoɔ nnyane koraa a, adɛn nti nso na wɔma wɔbɔ wɔn asu ma wɔn? 30#Rom 8.36 Adɛn nti na yɛn nso amaneɛ di yɛn akyi dɔn biara yi? 31#2 Ko 4.10-11 Meka mo ho ahohoahoa a mewɔ no yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu mu sɛ, mewu da biara. 32#Yes 22.13 Ɔko a mene mmoa koo no Efeso no, mekoo no nnipam a, anka ɛyɛ me mfasoɔ bɛn? Sɛ awufoɔ nnyane a,
ɛnneɛ momma yɛnnidi, na yɛnnom,
na ɔkyena na yɛawu!
33Mommma wɔnnnaadaa mo!
Fekuo bɔne sɛe ɔbra pa.
34 # Rom 13.11; Efe 5.14; Aso 26.8; 1 Ko 6.5 Momma mo ani nna hɔ, tenenee mu, na monnyɛ bɔne, ɛfiri sɛ ebinom nni Nyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ. Meka yei mehyɛ mo aniwuo.
Ɔsoro nipadua ne fam nipadua
35Na ebia obi bɛka sɛ: Wɔbɛyɛ dɛn anyane awufoɔ? Na nipadua bɛn na wɔde bɛba? 36#Yoh 12.24 Ɔkwasea! Deɛ wodua no rennya nkwa, gye sɛ ɛwu ansa. 37Na deɛ wodua no, ɛnyɛ dua a ɛbɛba na wodua, na mmom ɛyɛ aburoofua kwa, ebia ayuo anaa deɛ ɛkeka ho no bi. 38#Gye 1.11 Na Onyankopɔn ma no dua ko a ɔpɛ, na ɔma aba biara ɛno ara ne dua. 39Ɛnam nyinaa nyɛ pɛ; ɛsono nnipa nam, ɛsono ntɔteboa nam, ɛsono nnomaa nam, na ɛsono mpataa deɛ. 40Afei ɔsoro nnipadua ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ, na fam nnipadua ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ; ɛsono ɔsoro deɛ no animuonyam, na ɛsono fam deɛ no deɛ. 41Owia animuonyam nko, ɔsrane animuonyam nko, nsoromma animuonyam nko; na afei ɛsono nsoromma mmaako mmaako animuonyam.
Ɔkra nipadua ne honhom nipadua
42Sɛ nso awufoɔ sɔreɛ teɛ ne no. Wɔdua no porɔeɛ mu, ɛbɛnyane deɛ ɛmporɔ mu. 43#Flp 3.20-21 Wɔdua no deɛ ɛnni anidie mu, ɛbɛnyane animuonyam mu. Wɔdua no mmerɛyɛ mu, ɛbɛnyane tumi mu. 44Wɔdua no ɔkra nipadua, ɛbɛnyane honhom nipadua. Sɛdeɛ ɔkra nipadua wɔ hɔ no, saa ara nso na honhom nipadua nso wɔ hɔ. 45#Gye 2.7; 2 Ko 3.17 Saa ara nso na wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Adam, onipa a ɔdi kan no, bɛyɛɛ ɔkra teasefoɔ. Adam a ɔdi akyire no bɛyɛɛ honhom a ɔma nkwa. 46Na ɛnyɛ honhom deɛ no na ɛdi kan, na mmom ɔkra deɛ no, ansa na honhom deɛ no reba. 47Onipa a ɔdi kan no firi fam yɛ famni. Onipa a ɔtɔ so mmienu no firi soro. 48Sɛdeɛ famni no teɛ no, sɛ nso famfoɔ no teɛ ne no; na sɛdeɛ ɔsoroni no teɛ no, sɛ nso ɔsorofoɔ no teɛ ne no. 49#Gye 5.3 Na sɛdeɛ yɛhyɛɛ famni no suban no, sɛ nso yɛbɛhyɛ ɔsoroni no suban ne no.
Ɛsɛ sɛ nipadua no sakyera
50 # 1 Ko 6.13 Anuanom, deɛ mereka ne sɛ: Honam ne mogya ntumi nnya Nyankopɔn ahennie, na deɛ ɛporɔ no nso ntumi nnye deɛ ɛmporɔ. 51#1 Te 4.15; 4.17 Hwɛ, mereka mo ahuntasɛm: Yɛn nyinaa renna, na yɛn nyinaa bɛsakyera 52#Mat 24.31; 1 Te 4.16 ntɛm so, mpofirim, totorobɛnto a ɛdi akyire no hyɛn mu; na wɔbɛhyɛn totorobɛnto na awufoɔ no anyane sɛ wɔn a wɔmporɔɔ da, na yɛn deɛ yɛbɛsakyera. 53#2 Ko 5.4 Na ɛtwa sɛ deɛ ɛporɔ yi hyɛ deɛ ɛmporɔ no, na deɛ ɛwuo yi hyɛ deɛ ɛnwuo no. 54#Yes 25.8 Na sɛ deɛ ɛporɔ yi nya hyɛ deɛ ɛmporɔ no, na deɛ ɛwuo yi nya hyɛ deɛ ɛnwuo no a, ɛno na asɛm a wɔatwerɛ no bɛba mu sɛ:
Wɔamene owuo nkonim mu.
55 # Hos 13.14 O, owuo, wo nkonim wɔ he?
Owuo, wo nwowɔeɛ wɔ he?
56 # Rom 7.13; 6.14 Owuo nwowɔeɛ ne bɔne; na bɔne tumi ne mmara. 57Nanso aseda nka Onyankopɔn a ɔnam yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo so de nkonim ama yɛn.
58 # 2 Be 15.7 Enti, me nuanom, adɔfo, montintim, monnhinhim, monkɔ so Awurade adwuma mu daa, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ mo brɛ nyɛ kwa, Awurade mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Anuanom, afei merekae mo asɛmpa a mekaa mo, na mogyeeɛ nso, na mogyina mu nso, na afei wɔnam so gye mo nkwa no, sɛ mosɔ mu den sɛdeɛ mekaa mo asɛmpa no a, anyɛ saa deɛ a, na moagye adi kwa. Na nsɛm a adi kan a me nso menyaeɛ a mede mehyɛɛ mo nsa ne sɛ: Yɛn bɔne nti Kristo wui, sɛdeɛ twerɛ nsɛm no ka no. Na wɔsiee no, na ne nnansa soɔ no wɔnyanee no, sɛdeɛ twerɛ nsɛm no ka no. Na ɔmaa Kefa hunuu no, ansa na dummienu no rehu no. Ɛno akyiri no, ɔmaa anuanom bɛboro ahanum hunuu no prɛko; wɔn mu pii da so te ase, na ebinom adeda. Ɛno akyiri no, ɔmaa Yakobo hunuu no ansa na asomafoɔ no nyinaa rehu no. Wɔn nyinaa akyiri na ɔmaa me a mete sɛ deɛ wɔapatu awo no nso hunuu no.
Na mene asomafoɔ no mu akumaa a mensɛ sɛ wɔfrɛ me ɔsomafoɔ mpo, ɛfiri sɛ metaa Nyankopɔn asafo no; nanso Nyankopɔn adom nti na mete sɛdeɛ meteɛ yi; na n’adom a ɔde dom me no anyɛ kwa, na mmom meyɛɛ adwuma bebree mesene wɔn nyinaa, nanso ɛnyɛ me a, na mmom Nyankopɔn adom a ɛka me ho no a. Enti sɛ me oo, sɛ wɔn oo, saa na yɛka, na saa na mogye diiɛ.

Na sɛ wɔka no Kristo ho sɛ wɔanyane no afiri awufoɔ mu a, adɛn na mo mu binom ka sɛ: Awufoɔ sɔreɛ nni hɔ? Na sɛ awufoɔ sɔreɛ nni hɔ a, na wɔannyane Kristo nso; na sɛ wɔannyane Kristo a, na yɛn asɛnka yɛ ɔkwa, na mo gyidie nso yɛ hunu. Na wɔbɛhu yɛn sɛ Nyankopɔn ho adansekurumfoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ yɛdii Onyankopɔn adanseɛ sɛ, ɔnyanee Kristo, na sɛ awufoɔ nnyane a, ɛnneɛ na wannyane ɔno nso. Na sɛ awufoɔ nnyane a, na wɔannyane Kristo nso. Na sɛ wɔannyane Kristo a, na mo gyidie yɛ hunu, na moda so wɔ mo bɔne mu. Ɛno deɛ na wɔn a wɔdedaa Kristo mu no ayera. Sɛ nkwa yi mu nko ara na yɛwɔ Kristo mu anidasoɔ a, ɛnneɛ na yɛne nnipa nyinaa mu mmɔborɔfoɔ.

Nanso afei deɛ, wɔanyane Kristo afiri awufoɔ mu ayɛ wɔn a wɔadeda no mu aduaba a ɛdi kan. Na sɛdeɛ ɛnam onipa so na owuo baeɛ no, sɛ nso awufoɔ sɔreɛ nam onipa so baeɛ ne no. Na sɛdeɛ wɔn nyinaa wu Adam mu no, sɛ nso wɔn nyinaa bɛnya nkwa Kristo mu ne no. Na obiara wɔ ne diberɛ; Kristo ne aduaba a ɛdi kan, ansa na wɔn a wɔyɛ Kristo dea, ne ba mu no, di hɔ, ansa na awieeɛ no di hɔ, ɛberɛ a ɔde ahennie no bɛhyɛ Agya Nyankopɔn nsa, na watu ahennie ne ahoɔden ne tumi nyinaa aguo no. Na ɛtwa sɛ ɔdi hene kɔsi sɛ ɔde atamfoɔ no nyinaa bɛhyɛ ne nan ase. Ɔtamfoɔ a ɔdi akyire a ɔbɛtu no aguo no ne owuo. Na ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa agu ne nan ase. Na sɛ ɔka sɛ ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa agu ne nan ase a, emu da hɔ pefee sɛ deɛ ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa guu ne nan ase no nka ho. Na sɛ ɔnya de nnoɔma nyinaa gu ne nan ase a, ɛno ansa na ɔba no ara nso de ne ho bɛhyɛ deɛ ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa guu ne nan ase no aseɛ, na Onyankopɔn ayɛ ade nyinaa mu ade nyinaa.

Na anka wɔn a wɔma wɔbɔ wɔn asu ma awufoɔ no, wɔyɛ de gye deɛn? Sɛ awufoɔ nnyane koraa a, adɛn nti nso na wɔma wɔbɔ wɔn asu ma wɔn? Adɛn nti na yɛn nso amaneɛ di yɛn akyi dɔn biara yi? Meka mo ho ahohoahoa a mewɔ no yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu mu sɛ, mewu da biara. Ɔko a mene mmoa koo no Efeso no, mekoo no nnipam a, anka ɛyɛ me mfasoɔ bɛn? Sɛ awufoɔ nnyane a,
ɛnneɛ momma yɛnnidi, na yɛnnom,
na ɔkyena na yɛawu!
Mommma wɔnnnaadaa mo!
Fekuo bɔne sɛe ɔbra pa.
Momma mo ani nna hɔ, tenenee mu, na monnyɛ bɔne, ɛfiri sɛ ebinom nni Nyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ. Meka yei mehyɛ mo aniwuo.

Na ebia obi bɛka sɛ: Wɔbɛyɛ dɛn anyane awufoɔ? Na nipadua bɛn na wɔde bɛba? Ɔkwasea! Deɛ wodua no rennya nkwa, gye sɛ ɛwu ansa. Na deɛ wodua no, ɛnyɛ dua a ɛbɛba na wodua, na mmom ɛyɛ aburoofua kwa, ebia ayuo anaa deɛ ɛkeka ho no bi. Na Onyankopɔn ma no dua ko a ɔpɛ, na ɔma aba biara ɛno ara ne dua. Ɛnam nyinaa nyɛ pɛ; ɛsono nnipa nam, ɛsono ntɔteboa nam, ɛsono nnomaa nam, na ɛsono mpataa deɛ. Afei ɔsoro nnipadua ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ, na fam nnipadua ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ; ɛsono ɔsoro deɛ no animuonyam, na ɛsono fam deɛ no deɛ. Owia animuonyam nko, ɔsrane animuonyam nko, nsoromma animuonyam nko; na afei ɛsono nsoromma mmaako mmaako animuonyam.

Sɛ nso awufoɔ sɔreɛ teɛ ne no. Wɔdua no porɔeɛ mu, ɛbɛnyane deɛ ɛmporɔ mu. Wɔdua no deɛ ɛnni anidie mu, ɛbɛnyane animuonyam mu. Wɔdua no mmerɛyɛ mu, ɛbɛnyane tumi mu. Wɔdua no ɔkra nipadua, ɛbɛnyane honhom nipadua. Sɛdeɛ ɔkra nipadua wɔ hɔ no, saa ara nso na honhom nipadua nso wɔ hɔ. Saa ara nso na wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Adam, onipa a ɔdi kan no, bɛyɛɛ ɔkra teasefoɔ. Adam a ɔdi akyire no bɛyɛɛ honhom a ɔma nkwa. Na ɛnyɛ honhom deɛ no na ɛdi kan, na mmom ɔkra deɛ no, ansa na honhom deɛ no reba. Onipa a ɔdi kan no firi fam yɛ famni. Onipa a ɔtɔ so mmienu no firi soro. Sɛdeɛ famni no teɛ no, sɛ nso famfoɔ no teɛ ne no; na sɛdeɛ ɔsoroni no teɛ no, sɛ nso ɔsorofoɔ no teɛ ne no. Na sɛdeɛ yɛhyɛɛ famni no suban no, sɛ nso yɛbɛhyɛ ɔsoroni no suban ne no.

Anuanom, deɛ mereka ne sɛ: Honam ne mogya ntumi nnya Nyankopɔn ahennie, na deɛ ɛporɔ no nso ntumi nnye deɛ ɛmporɔ. Hwɛ, mereka mo ahuntasɛm: Yɛn nyinaa renna, na yɛn nyinaa bɛsakyera ntɛm so, mpofirim, totorobɛnto a ɛdi akyire no hyɛn mu; na wɔbɛhyɛn totorobɛnto na awufoɔ no anyane sɛ wɔn a wɔmporɔɔ da, na yɛn deɛ yɛbɛsakyera. Na ɛtwa sɛ deɛ ɛporɔ yi hyɛ deɛ ɛmporɔ no, na deɛ ɛwuo yi hyɛ deɛ ɛnwuo no. Na sɛ deɛ ɛporɔ yi nya hyɛ deɛ ɛmporɔ no, na deɛ ɛwuo yi nya hyɛ deɛ ɛnwuo no a, ɛno na asɛm a wɔatwerɛ no bɛba mu sɛ:
Wɔamene owuo nkonim mu.
O, owuo, wo nkonim wɔ he?
Owuo, wo nwowɔeɛ wɔ he?
Owuo nwowɔeɛ ne bɔne; na bɔne tumi ne mmara. Nanso aseda nka Onyankopɔn a ɔnam yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo so de nkonim ama yɛn.
Enti, me nuanom, adɔfo, montintim, monnhinhim, monkɔ so Awurade adwuma mu daa, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ mo brɛ nyɛ kwa, Awurade mu.

app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
